card.name: Sulfite allergic-type reaction warning
card.fires_on: The words "allergic" and "reactions" in the stock sentence saying a sulfite (sodium metabisulfite or sodium sulfite) may cause allergic-type reactions including anaphylactic symptoms.

modes.label: Allergic before -type
modes.description: The word "allergic" right after "a sulfite that may cause", where "reactions" is expected next.
modes.example: a sulfite that may cause<< allergic>>-type reactions including anaphylactic symptoms

modes.label: Reactions after allergic-type
modes.description: The word "reactions" after "allergic-type" in the same sulfite sentence.
modes.example: a sulfite that may cause allergic-type<< reactions>> including anaphylactic symptoms and life

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce "reaction" and its variants as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the standard sulfite warning sentence about allergic-type reactions, where the word "reaction" comes next or has just appeared.
